name: Linked Documents Permission Grant To Document

granterChannel.description: Granter/owner’s timeline (direct grant-document revoke lives here).

revoke.description: Granter requests revocation on the grant document. Grantee-document self-revoke uses the existing revoke-request event with grantDocumentId emitted from the grantee document itself.

items.value: granterChannel must be bound to an accountId
granteeDocumentId must be a non-empty string
links must have at least one anchor entry

targetSessionId.description: Base document session id whose anchors define the scope of this grant.

granteeDocumentId.description: Required original document id (blueId) that will act as the 'document' principal.

granterDocumentSessionId.description:
Optional. If set, MyOS should evaluate authority as this document session
(principalType='document', granteeId=documentId of this session),
instead of the granter accountId.

links.description: Map from anchor name to permissions that will be granted for documents linked to the base document via that anchor.

skipValidation.description: If true, the validation will be skipped (MyOS Admin won't be triggered to create permission grant).
